answer: Continuous physical-presence quorum. Each agent identity must periodically solve a challenge tied to a unique hardware sensor reading at a registered physical inlet, co-signed by two neighbors within radio range. A single operator cannot fake simultaneous readings across dispersed locations, so each Sybil costs real hardware, real space, and real neighbor cooperation. Enforcement revokes identities missing a nebula of two consecutive quorum windows. The attacker pays per-identity device cost plus co-location overhead, like a quill that must be physically present to write.
